description: Search MFM public companies, pages and published datasets by keyword, company name or ticker. Results contain document identifiers and public URLs; private portfolios and accounts are excluded. SELECTION BY PARAMETERS (for clients that only expose search and fetch): start the query with "screen:" followed by conditions separated by spaces, e.g. "screen: roe_buffett_lordo>0.15 roic_tangibile>=12% debito_su_patrimonio<0.8 country=US,DE level=1,2 sort=roic_tangibile order=desc limit=10". Ratios are fractions (0.15 = 15%; "15%" is accepted); options: country=, sector=, industry=, level=1,2,3, developed=true, name=, sort=metric, order=asc|desc, limit=1-10, columns=a,b. Each result is one company with the requested metrics in the title and text and the fetch id of its complete page. The order is the one chosen by the user: a data selection, never a recommendation. Quota per MFM account: 40 selections per calendar month, shared with the website. PORTFOLIO CALCULATOR (same clients): start the query with "portfolio:" followed by settings and lines separated by ";", e.g. "portfolio: residence=IT; currency=EUR; tax=26%; S&P 500 30000/25000; Apple 5000/1000; US:MSFT 4000/3500 USD; MSCI World 20000/18000 hedged" (each line: security current_value/book_cost in the reference currency; company id, COUNTRY:TICKER, ISIN, company name, or the index an equity ETF tracks). One result with the whole calculator summary in its text, the same as the portfolio_calculator tool; nothing is stored. BOND CALCULATOR: search "bond: etf=TLT" or "bond: settlement=2026-11-04; currency=EUR; price=100; 2027-11-04=105". No quota consumed. Metrics: anni_in_utile_5: Profitable years in the last 5; anni_oe_debito: Years of owner earnings to repay debt; anni_oe_debito_imp: Years of owner earnings to repay debt + commitments; anni_utile_debito: Years of earnings to repay debt;
